finding.title: Route hebrew_date_picker.dart's dialog title/labels through AppLocalizations — hardcoded English leaks into Hebrew locale
finding.area: features/scheduler/presentation/widgets (live dialog, used by goal_setup_screen.dart and tracks/setup/step_goal.dart)
finding.why: A Hebrew-locale user opening Add Track / Goal Setup > pick a Hebrew deadline sees a dialog titled in raw English ('Select Hebrew date'), with 'Hebrew year', 'Month', 'Day' field labels and an 'English:' confirmation prefix all in English, while the Cancel/Select-date buttons on the same dialog ARE correctly localized (AppLocalizations.actionCancel/schedulerSelectDate) — a jarring mixed-language dialog in an app whose entire premise is EN/HE parity. The test file's own assertions (line 33, 46) require these exact English literals and never pump a Locale('he') variant, so the test suite actively pins the bug as correct output rather than catching it.
finding.recommendation: Add ARB keys (title, 'Hebrew year' label, month/day field labels, 'English:' prefix) and route all 5 literals through AppLocalizations.of(context)!; add a Locale('he') testWidgets case to hebrew_date_picker_test.dart asserting the Hebrew strings render, mirroring the RTL-smoke pattern already used in study_day_config_screen_l1_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: No literal 'Select Hebrew date', 'Hebrew year', 'Month', 'Day', or 'English:' string remains in hebrew_date_picker.dart (grep returns zero).
make arb-parity still passes with the new keys present in both app_en.arb and app_he.arb.
hebrew_date_picker_test.dart gains a Locale('he') case asserting the Hebrew-ARB strings render for title/year-label/month/day.
